import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    b = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    
    prices = []
    if n > 1:
        balance = 1 if a[0] % 2 == 1 else -1
        for i in range(1, n - 1):
            balance += 1 if a[i] % 2 == 1 else -1
            if balance == 0:
                prices.append(abs(a[i + 1] - a[i]))
    
    prices.sort()
    ans = 0
    for cost in prices:
        if b < cost:
            break
        b -= cost
        ans += 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
